description: A ready-to-deliver construction toolbox talk from Jobsite's library of nearly 300 talks, in English or Spanish: title, talking points, a discussion question, duration, and the OSHA standards it is built on. Find one by topic or hazard in plain words ("trenching", "heat", "ladder setup") or by standard number ("1926.501"), or fetch one by talk_number. Returns the best match plus up to five other matching titles.

talk_number.description: Or one talk by its number (from other_matches).

topic.description: The hazard, task or standard, e.g. "trench cave-ins", "silica", "1926.1053".
